#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class FastReader {
public:
    FastReader() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
    }

    string nextLine() {
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        return line;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        cin.ignore(numeric_limits<streamsize>::max(), '\n');
        return n;
    }
};

class TaskB {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, FastReader& in) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        string str = in.nextLine();
        if (n <= 0) {
            cout << "0 0";
            return;
        }

        string s = str.substr(0, n);
        vector<string> tokens;
        string curToken;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
                if (!curToken.empty()) {
                    tokens.push_back(curToken);
                    curToken.clear();
                }
                tokens.push_back(string(1, c));
            } else {
                curToken += c;
            }
        }
        if (!curToken.empty()) {
            tokens.push_back(curToken);
        }

        bool inside = false;
        int curLen = 0;
        int insideWords = 0;
        int maxLen = 0;

        for (const string& token : tokens) {
            if (token == "_" || token == "(" || token == ")") {
                if (curLen > 0) {
                    if (inside) insideWords++;
                    else if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
                    curLen = 0;
                }
                char c = token[0];
                if (c == '(') inside = true;
                else if (c == ')') inside = false;
            } else {
                curLen += token.size();
            }
        }

        if (curLen > 0) {
            if (inside) insideWords++;
            else if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
        }

        cout << maxLen << " " << insideWords;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    FastReader in;
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(1, in);
    return 0;
}
